name: pure blue
source:
Main character lies in the hospital for a long time, and only one person visits him. Protagonist's wish is to see the sea. Will his dream come true?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-october-2008-volume-7.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角长期住院，只有一个人前来看望他。他的愿望是看见大海。这个梦想能够实现吗？

[译自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-october-2008-volume-7.html]vndbreview[/url]]
